verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of choosing a data storage region or residency, such as EU or US hosting or region selection at project creation. Warehouse Native runs analysis in the customer's own data warehouse, but the evidence never frames this as a residency or region control. That makes it an adjacent feature, not the capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
